author: packs
description: F11-T10: the revenue reports as stored queries over the schedule lines and balance snapshots: the waterfall of planned revenue by period, the deferred roll-forward, unbilled balances, remaining performance obligations per contract, and recognised against billed per customer.
name: ledger-revenue-reports

definition.name: Revenue: Waterfall
definition.sql: SELECT s.fiscal_period, SUM(s.amount_contract_ccy) AS planned, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM revenue_schedule_line s WHERE s.status = 'planned' AND (s.is_active IS NULL OR s.is_active = true) GROUP BY s.fiscal_period ORDER BY s.fiscal_period

definition.name: Revenue: Deferred Roll-forward
definition.sql: SELECT b.fiscal_period, SUM(b.billed_to_date) AS billed_to_date, SUM(b.recognised_to_date) AS recognised_to_date, SUM(b.deferred) AS deferred FROM revenue_balance_snapshot b WHERE (b.is_active IS NULL OR b.is_active = true) GROUP BY b.fiscal_period ORDER BY b.fiscal_period

definition.name: Revenue: Unbilled Balance
definition.sql: SELECT c.customer_account_ref, b.revenue_contract_ref, b.fiscal_period, b.unbilled FROM revenue_balance_snapshot b JOIN revenue_contract c ON c.id = b.revenue_contract_ref WHERE b.unbilled > 0 AND (b.is_active IS NULL OR b.is_active = true) AND b.fiscal_period = (SELECT MAX(x.fiscal_period) FROM revenue_balance_snapshot x WHERE x.revenue_contract_ref = b.revenue_contract_ref AND (x.is_active IS NULL OR x.is_active = true)) ORDER BY b.unbilled DESC

definition.name: Revenue: Remaining Performance Obligations
definition.sql: SELECT c.id AS revenue_contract_ref, c.customer_account_ref, c.currency, SUM(s.amount_contract_ccy) AS remaining, MIN(s.fiscal_period) AS from_period, MAX(s.fiscal_period) AS to_period FROM revenue_contract c JOIN performance_obligation o ON o.revenue_contract_ref = c.id JOIN revenue_schedule_line s ON s.obligation_ref = o.id WHERE s.status = 'planned' AND (c.is_active IS NULL OR c.is_active = true) AND (o.is_active IS NULL OR o.is_active = true) AND (s.is_active IS NULL OR s.is_active = true) GROUP BY c.id, c.customer_account_ref, c.currency ORDER BY remaining DESC

definition.name: Revenue: Recognised vs Billed by Customer
definition.sql: SELECT c.customer_account_ref, SUM(b.recognised_to_date) AS recognised_to_date, SUM(b.billed_to_date) AS billed_to_date, SUM(b.deferred) AS deferred, SUM(b.unbilled) AS unbilled FROM revenue_balance_snapshot b JOIN revenue_contract c ON c.id = b.revenue_contract_ref WHERE (b.is_active IS NULL OR b.is_active = true) AND b.fiscal_period = (SELECT MAX(x.fiscal_period) FROM revenue_balance_snapshot x WHERE x.revenue_contract_ref = b.revenue_contract_ref AND (x.is_active IS NULL OR x.is_active = true)) GROUP BY c.customer_account_ref ORDER BY recognised_to_date DESC

target.query: Revenue: Recognised vs Billed by Customer

title: Pack: revenue reports
